title: GHO__PAY
tagline: Pay in $GHO, Receive any way you want without any gas. FAST AND EFFORTLESS
description:
GhoPay is a simple yet powerful payment platform that lets users send money using $GHO, a cryptocurrency, with the option for receivers to get paid in either $GHO or Indian Rupees (INR). This dual-currency feature makes GhoPay versatile, catering to those who prefer the traditional stability of fiat money and those excited about the potential of digital currencies.

The platform stands out by removing transaction fees, making it accessible and attractive for both individual users and merchants. Without the worry of extra charges, GhoPay aims to encourage more people and businesses to embrace digital transactions, whether for everyday purchases or larger, more significant payments.

For INR transactions, GhoPay utilizes the Unified Payments Interface (UPI), known for its speed and reliability across India. Meanwhile, $GHO transactions leverage smart contracts for security and efficiency. Making a payment is as easy as scanning a QR code, demonstrating GhoPay's focus on user-friendly design. Fast, secure, and free of transaction fees, GhoPay offers a practical solution for today's digital payment needs.
how_its_made:
This project uses $GHO stablecoin for money transfers, Unified Payments Interface (UPI) for web2 (INR) payments, ConnectKit to connect wallets, hardhat for contracts, NextJS and some other small integrations.

Once the user scans the QR Code, based. on the option chosen by recipient, the transaction is either GHO to GHO or GHO to INR. The platform is gas less utilizing permit.

Both transactions are instantaneous.
